question: What worship follows opening his mouth?
premises: he is made to bow at the feet
the goddess-circle is worshipped on his hands and head
inference: after opening the mouth, one makes him bow and worships the goddess-circle
uncertainties: whether hastayormūrdhni means hands and head or head of hands
plain_english: Then, opening his mouth, make him bow at the feet; on his hands and head also worship the goddess-circle.
